subject: general
question: The Palace of Assembly is a legislative assembly designed by noted architect Le Corbusier and is located in ______.

options.text: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu

solution:
The correct answer is __**Chandigarh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Le Corbusier, a renowned architect, **created the Palace of Assembly, a legislative building in **Chandigarh, India.**
 
• The Legislative Assembly, Secretariat, and High Court are three of the structures that make up **The Capitol Complex.**
 
• Punjab had to find a new capital after being separated in **1947 **as a result of India's independence because** Lahore was now part of Pakistan.**
 
• As a result, **Jawaharlal Nehru, the first prime minister of India, hired Le Corbusier to design the new city of Chandigarh.**
 
• A city **"unbound by the traditions of the past, a symbol of the nation's faith in the future"** was to be created, according to the design brief. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Le Corbusier** was a** French-Swiss architect, designer, painter, writer, and advocate of modern architecture.**
 
• Having been born in **Switzerland, he acquired French citizenship in 1930.**
 
• In the five decades of his work, he designed structures in North and South America, Europe, Japan, and India.
 
• The architectural work of Le Corbusier, an Outstanding Contribution to the Modern Movement, was inscribed as one of 17 Le Corbusier projects across seven nations on the UNESCO World Heritage List on July 17, 2016.
